doc: Mortar team (3 mortars, 20-90 m, standing only) attack-moves on an unarmed dummy from 60 m, with a disarmed friendly spotter 25 m short of it (sight 40 m, so the spotter gives the mortars the target). The mortar behaviour (sw-txnj.11, humanity.json mortar_attack_move) keeps the team at least min_range + 5 = 25 m out (keep_distance) and never fires on the move. Pinned absolute DPS over the first contact turn; the distance floor is the acceptance check.

probes.doc: Team DPS from its first shot at the dummy over the scenario's two turns (the first contact window), 6.0 (5%). Pinned by sw-txnj.11.
After turn 1: the team stays at or beyond min_range + 5 = 25 m (it stands at its 60 m firing position).
Last frame: the team stays at or beyond min_range + 5 = 25 m.
